about: Per-voice data coverage (PM 2026-11-03). required_fields is GENERATED from the canon locks by tools/build_voice_coverage.py. conditional_blank and known_gaps are HAND-REVIEWED. check.py coverage classifies every required field: SERVED; NOT SERVED - on the voice's menu but absent or blank everywhere (a data gap); AQE GAP - not on the menu AND not an AQE export field (a data gap); OFF MY MENU - not on the menu but AQE does export it (a menu choice, never a gap). A NOT SERVED / AQE GAP field blocks unless it is in known_gaps, where it is printed on every run but does not block. A NEW gap always blocks.

conditional_blank.bracket.*: AQE glossary: a bracket field is null when the name has no valid structural bracket (house rule R1: a bracket is never a reject)
conditional_blank.structure_shift_ref: AQE glossary: null for a RANGE structure_shift (no broken level to measure against)
